mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_client_allowed_daily_total(daily_total_id, client_id, event_code, currency, event_date, amount, event_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.dailyTotalId}, #{row.clientId}, #{row.eventCode}, #{row.currency}, #{row.eventDate}, #{row.amount}, #{row.eventCount}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE amount = amount + #{row.amount}, event_count = event_count + #{row.eventCount}, update_time = #{row.updateTime}
mapper.select: SELECT currency, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN event_date = #{today} THEN amount END), 0) AS amountToday, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amountLast30Days FROM t_client_allowed_daily_total WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND event_code = #{eventCode} AND event_date >= #{fromDate} AND event_date <= #{today} GROUP BY currency ORDER BY currency
